label: Every sentence the Storage clean-up says and sends

params.name: no_files
params.default: This account holds no files. There is nothing to ask for.

params.name: all_sent
params.default: All {max} requests have gone. From the delete date you may delete their files.

params.name: too_soon
params.default: The next reminder can go from {date} — {gap_days} days after the last one.

params.name: not_yet
params.default: Not yet. Deleting someone's files needs all {max} requests sent and {delete_after_days} days since the first{when}.

params.name: pick_one
params.default: Pick at least one of their items.

params.name: no_mail
params.default: Email is not set up; they will see it as a banner in the portal.

params.name: mail_failed
params.default: The email failed ({error}); they will still see it as a banner in the portal.

params.name: subject_reminder
params.default: {product}: reminder {n} of {max} — please clean up your files

params.name: body
params.default:
Hello {name},

Your account on {product} holds {size} in {files} files{since}.

Disk space on this portal is shared. Please delete what you no longer need:
{link}

{note_block}{reminder_line}From {delete_date} the portal owner may delete files that are still here.

params.name: note_block
params.default:
A note from the portal owner:
{note}

params.name: deleted_subject
params.default: {product}: some of your files were deleted

params.name: deleted_body
no_limits
params.default: This portal sets no storage limits.

params.name: limits_saved
params.default: Storage limits saved. Anyone with limits of their own keeps them.

description_nl: Errors on the Storage screen and the three request emails plus the deletion notice. {product}, {name}, {size}, {files}, {since}, {link}, {note_block}, {reminder_line}, {delete_date}, {n}, {max}, {date}, {count}, {items} fill in. no_account is the answer for an unknown person; delete_date_note fills {when} in not_yet.
